feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 4 June 2026 5:34am
items.description:
##Today##

Showers, heavy at times, and frequent this morning, becoming scattered this afternoon with a few sunny intervals developing, then only isolated showers this evening. Mostly dry overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

5-10


##Wind Speed##

23


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

SW or W-SW veering W, 20-25, but occasionally 25-30 in places, decreasing 15-20 late in the night.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate showers. Hill fog at times.


##Comments##

Strong wind.


##Tomorrow##

A generally dry and bright day with spells of sunshine and only a small risk of an isolated shower. Then rain arrives overnight into Saturday.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-5 later


##Wind Speed##

17


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

W or SW 15-20, backing South 12-17, then SE 17-22 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming mostly moderate overnight. Hill fog later.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Saturday, 6 June 2026##

Rain, possibly turning heavier at times, easing off mid to late afternoon then clearing away in the evening.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-7


##Wind Speed##

24


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

SE 20-25, occasionally 25-30 in places for a time, veering W 15-25 later, backing SW overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor at times in the rain. Hill fog until later.


##Comments##

Strong wind.


##Sunday, 7 June 2026##

Mostly fine to fair morning with some hazy sunshine, risk of isolated showers during afternoon, then rain developing evening / night.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

3-8 later


##Wind Speed##

23


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW backing SSW or S for a while, 20-25, occasionally 25-30 in places, decreasing 15-20 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor later with hill fog.


##Comments##

Low confidence for details of rain later.


##Monday, 8 June 2026##

Rain at first, then mainly dry with sunny intervals developing, just a few isolated showers later.

2-4

W

SW veering W, 15-20.
